get.summary:
What the app or website reads at start, for its platform. Public. Always revalidated: send
the last ETag in If-None-Match; an unchanged config answers 304 with no body.
Liveness: the process serves HTTP. Checks no dependencies, so ECS doesn't restart on a DB blip.
Readiness: the load balancer only sends traffic when the database answers.

post.summary:
Starts a guest session: browse and watch free episodes without an account (deep dive 1, B3).
Off when guest mode is off. Limited per device and network, more tightly without a passed
device check (which never blocks on its own).

Sends a login code that works only from this device (clientId) for 5 minutes. Waits 30, 60,
then 120 s between codes; per number 5 an hour and 10 a day; per device 10 a day and per
network 20 an hour (half without a passed device check); 10 wrong codes a day lock the
number for an hour. The answer is the same whether or not the number has an account.

Checks the code and logs in on the given device, creating the account on first login. Sent
with the guest session's `Authorization`, the guest's data comes along: a new number turns
the guest into the account, an existing account takes it in. An expired guest token is a 401
(refresh it and retry; the code is not used up); any other token is ignored.

Finishes a login that answered 409 device-limit: signs the chosen device out (its sessions
end at once) and logs in on the new one. The ticket works once, for 5 minutes.

Finishes a login that answered 409 recycled-number-check (the number may have a new owner).
usedBefore true logs in to the account; false closes it (kept 30 days for support to
recover, signed out everywhere) and the number starts a new account, in onboarding.
Swaps a refresh token for a new pair. Each refresh token works once.
Ends the session on this device and every token issued from the same login.

Emails a code that works only from this device for 5 minutes, to sign up or set a new
password. The same waits and limits as login codes by SMS. The answer is the same whether or
not the address has an account.

Proves the address with its code, sets the password (a new account, or a new password that
signs the other devices out) and logs in. With a guest session, the guest comes along.
Logs in with the password. A wrong password and an unknown address get the same answer.

Logs in with the ID token from Google's sign-in SDK. A Google account seen before reaches its
account; otherwise an email Google verified joins the account that proved it; otherwise a new
account (or the guest, converted). With a guest session, the guest comes along.

Logs in with Sign in with Apple. The nonce must be the one whose hash the app gave Apple for
this sign-in. Apple's email counts as verified (it may be a private relay address). The name,
sent only the first time, becomes the display name if none is set.
Adds Google with a fresh ID token. 409 login-method-in-use if another account has it.
Adds Sign in with Apple, as at login (nonce, code).
Adds an email login: the code from POST /v1/auth/email/code (this device) and a password.

delete.summary: Removes a login method with a step-up code (POST /v1/me/step-up); never the last.

post.summary:

episode-not-found; 409 language-unavailable (with languages), media-not-ready; 403 pin-required;
402 not-entitled; 429 playback-rate-limited.

Checks everything again, then marks it started. 404 playback-session-not-found (not this
device's); 410 playback-session-ended; and create's answers when something changed since.
Ends the session: its stream slot is free. Ending it again changes nothing.

coins.description: Coins that can be spent, and any owed.

dueBy.description: When we answer by at the latest: our response period (ISO).

outcome.description: What was done, or why it was rejected; null while open.

consent.description: The consent in force; null if never given.

processors.description: Who receives data, why and what.

responseDays.description: Days we take to answer a request at most.

kind.description: access: a summary of the data; correction; erasure; nomination (acting for someone).

details.description: What to correct, and the like.

kind.description: support: a question or problem; grievance: a formal complaint, with the legal clocks.

series.description: The series it is about, if any (its short ID).

email.description: Where to answer: needed when the account has no email (a guest, or a phone-only account).

requestId.description: The request ID of the last error the app showed, to find what happened.

acknowledgeBy.description: A grievance's clocks: acknowledged by, decided by (ISO); null for support.

message.description: What is wrong, in the viewer's words.

email.description: Where to answer: needed when the account has no email.

acknowledgeBy.description: A grievance's clocks: acknowledged by, decided by (ISO); null for support.

series.description: The series and episode it is about, if any.

decision.description: The decision and its reasons, once decided.

appealUrl.description: Where a decided grievance may be appealed (the self-regulatory body); null otherwise.

expiresOn.description: The last IST day they can be spent, YYYY-MM-DD ("40 expire on 15 Nov").

promo.description: Promo coins that can still be spent.

promoByExpiry.description: The promo coins by the day they end, soonest first.

debt.description: Coins owed from a refund of coins already spent.

type.description: purchase: coins bought; bonus: free coins; unlock: coins spent; undo: an unlock reversed; expiry: promo coins ended; refund: a purchase reversed.

coins.description: The change to the coins the member holds: plus when they came, minus when they went.

debt.description: The change to what is owed: plus when a refund left debt, minus when coins settled it.

source.description: Where free or bought coins came from (check-in, google, razorpay, ...); null otherwise.

ladder.description: The coins of each day of the ladder, from day 1.

today.description: The IST day it is now, YYYY-MM-DD; the day changes at midnight IST.

canClaim.description: Whether a claim would be accepted now.

nextStep.description: The ladder day the next claim is (tomorrow's, once today is claimed).

nextCoins.description: The coins of the next claim on this device (half where the device did not pass the check).

step.description: The ladder day, 1 is the first.

toBalanceDue.description: Of those, the coins that went to a balance due from a refund ("3 coins went to your balance due").

halved.description: Half coins, because the device did not pass the check.

expiresOn.description: The last IST day the coins can be spent.

widevineLevel.description: Android's Widevine level: L1 is hardware DRM, L3 software. Left out elsewhere.

dataSaver.description: The viewer's data saver: 360p at most.

language.description: The language version to watch, e.g. hi.

pinToken.description: A PIN token (POST /v1/me/pin/verify), when the viewer's PIN applies to the episode.

playable.description: Whether this viewer may watch it now (free, or theirs); when not, the paywall comes first.

playlistUrl.description: Our master playlist: only the allowed qualities, lowest first, each signed for itself.

expiresAt.description: When the playlist and segment tokens end (ISO).

drm.description: The DRM to use, or null: free episodes never use DRM, and paid DRM waits for Bunny (BE-44).

rating.description: The effective rating, for the rating card.

next.description: The episode after this one, or null when there is none to offer.

heartbeatSeconds.description: Send a heartbeat this often while playing, and at once on pause, seek, background and end.

resume.description:
Where to start, in seconds (deep dive 3, D5): the saved place, the same share in another dub; 0
without progress or when it was in the last 10% (offer the next episode).

licenceToken.description: The 60-second licence token, or null when the episode has no DRM (free episodes; BE-44).

autoUnlocked.description:
The auto-unlock this start made (deep dive 4, E3), for the toast "Episode 13 unlocked, 8 coins.
Undo" (POST /v1/unlocks/{unlockId}/undo); null when nothing was charged.

position.description: Where the player is, in seconds.

sequence.description: Counts up with each heartbeat of the session; an older one changes nothing.

status.description: revoked: stop playing (stopped from another device, ended, or its time is up).

reason.description: Why it was revoked: stopped, ended, expired, or a check that failed at start; null when ok.

sequence.description: The session's next sequence: the end is ordered with its heartbeats and queued updates.

series.description: The series' short ID and the episode's number.

Problem.description: Every error is application/problem+json (RFC 9457). Branch on `type`: `about:blank` is a generic HTTP error (404 unknown route, 400 validation with `errors`, other 4xx from the HTTP layer, 500); every other type is listed in `x-problem-types`.

ticket.description: Only on device-limit and recycled-number-check: send it to POST /v1/auth/device-limit/resolve or POST /v1/auth/recycled-number (5 minutes).

steps.description: Only on onboarding-required: the steps still needed, in order.

minimumAge.description: Only on age-below-minimum: the minimum age.

devices.description: Only on device-limit: the devices signed in, each as in GET /v1/me/devices (DeviceResponse); the viewer picks one to sign out.

urn:ott:error:language-unavailable.detail: This episode is not available in that language here.
urn:ott:error:language-unavailable.when: POST /v1/playback/sessions for a language the episode is not out in for this viewer; languages lists the ones it is.

urn:ott:error:media-not-ready.detail: This episode is not ready to play yet.
urn:ott:error:media-not-ready.when: POST /v1/playback/sessions for an episode whose video is not there to play.
urn:ott:error:media-not-ready.client: Say so, and try again later.

urn:ott:error:pin-required.detail: Enter your PIN to watch this.
urn:ott:error:pin-required.when: A playback session for an episode rated at or above where the viewer's parental PIN applies, without a good PIN token (POST /v1/me/pin/verify gives one).
urn:ott:error:pin-required.client: Ask for the PIN, then try again with its token.

urn:ott:error:not-entitled.detail: Unlock this episode to watch it.
urn:ott:error:not-entitled.when: A playback session for an episode that is not free, not unlocked by this account and not in its VIP.

urn:ott:error:playback-session-not-found.detail: That playback session does not exist.
urn:ott:error:playback-session-not-found.when: A playback session that is not this viewer's on this device, or does not exist.

urn:ott:error:playback-session-ended.when: A playback session that ended, was revoked, or whose tokens expired.

urn:ott:error:too-many-streams.detail: You are already watching on the most devices at once.
urn:ott:error:too-many-streams.when: Starting playback while the account plays on setting playback_streams_per_member other devices; streams lists them (id, the device, what it plays).
urn:ott:error:too-many-streams.client: List the streams and offer "Stop on that device" (DELETE /v1/me/streams/{id}).

urn:ott:error:playback-session-not-start.detail: That playback session has not started.
urn:ott:error:playback-session-not-start.when: A heartbeat for a session that was never started (POST .../start).

urn:ott:error:playback-rate-limited.detail: Too many plays started. Wait a moment.
urn:ott:error:playback-rate-limited.when: More playback sessions created in a minute than setting playback_creates_per_minute, by this account, this device or this address.
urn:ott:error:playback-rate-limited.client: Wait a minute, then try again.

urn:ott:error:playlist-forbidden.detail: This playlist link is not valid.
urn:ott:error:playlist-forbidden.when: GET of a playback playlist with a token that is wrong, of another session, or expired.

urn:ott:error:checkin-already-claimed.detail: You have already checked in today. The next check-in is at midnight (IST).
urn:ott:error:checkin-already-claimed.when: POST /v1/me/checkins when the account has claimed on this IST day.
urn:ott:error:checkin-already-claimed.client: Show today as claimed and the next day's tile.

urn:ott:error:checkin-unavailable.detail: Check-in is not available on this device today.
urn:ott:error:checkin-unavailable.when: POST /v1/me/checkins when the device has reached its daily limit, the account is waiting to be deleted, or check-in is off on the platform. The text never says which.
urn:ott:error:checkin-unavailable.client: Show the neutral message; try again tomorrow.

urn:ott:error:idempotency-key-required.detail: This request needs an Idempotency-Key header.
urn:ott:error:idempotency-key-required.when: A request that spends or gives coins, without a valid Idempotency-Key header (8 to 128 letters, digits, - _ . or :).
urn:ott:error:idempotency-key-required.client: Send a new random key with each new request, and the same key to retry it.

urn:ott:error:insufficient-coins.detail: You do not have enough coins.
urn:ott:error:insufficient-coins.when: A spend of more coins than the wallet can use now (expired promo coins do not count); coins says how many were asked for, balance how many can be used.

urn:ott:error:wallet-in-debt.detail: Your balance is settling an earlier refund. New coins settle it first.
urn:ott:error:wallet-in-debt.when: A spend while the wallet has debt (from a refund of coins already spent); debt says how many coins.
urn:ott:error:wallet-in-debt.client: Offer the coin store, saying the purchase settles the balance first.

urn:ott:error:idempotency-key-reused.detail: That Idempotency-Key was already used for a different request.
urn:ott:error:idempotency-key-reused.when: The same Idempotency-Key with a request that is not the one it first came with.
urn:ott:error:idempotency-key-reused.client: Use a new key for a new request; retry the same request with the same key.

urn:ott:error:price-changed.detail: The price has changed. Nothing was charged.
urn:ott:error:price-changed.when: An unlock whose expectedCoins is not the price now (an episode, or the series unlock); coins is the price now.
urn:ott:error:price-changed.client: Show the new price and ask again.

urn:ott:error:unlock-not-found.when: An undo of an unlock that does not exist or is not this account's.

urn:ott:error:unlock-undo-unavailable.detail: This unlock can no longer be undone.
urn:ott:error:unlock-undo-unavailable.when: An undo of an unlock that was not an auto-unlock, was undone already, or is past its window (setting unlock_undo_seconds: since the unlock, and of the episode played).

urn:ott:error:unauthenticated.when: No access token, a malformed one, or an expired one, on a route that needs login.
urn:ott:error:unauthenticated.client: Refresh the session once and retry; if refreshing fails, show login.

urn:ott:error:refresh-invalid.when: The refresh token is unknown, expired, revoked, or was already used (the whole session is then revoked).
urn:ott:error:refresh-invalid.client: Clear the session and show login.

urn:ott:error:account-suspended.when: Login or refresh for an account that support has suspended.
urn:ott:error:account-suspended.client: Show the suspended-account screen with the support and grievance links.

urn:ott:error:otp-too-soon.detail: Please wait 30 seconds before requesting a new code.
urn:ott:error:otp-too-soon.when: A new code is requested for the same number within 30 seconds.
urn:ott:error:otp-too-soon.client: Keep the resend countdown running; do not send again until it ends.

urn:ott:error:otp-rate-limited.detail: Too many codes requested. Try again later.
urn:ott:error:otp-rate-limited.when: Too many codes in the last hour for the number or for the network address.
urn:ott:error:otp-rate-limited.client: Show "try again later"; offer help. Do not retry automatically.

urn:ott:error:country-not-supported.detail: Phone numbers from this country are not supported yet.
urn:ott:error:country-not-supported.when: A code is requested for a number whose country is not open (setting sms.countries).
urn:ott:error:country-not-supported.client: Show the message under the number field; offer email, Google or Apple login.

urn:ott:error:ticket-not-found.detail: We could not find that ticket.
urn:ott:error:ticket-not-found.when: GET or reply to /v1/me/tickets/{id} for a ticket that is not this viewer’s.

urn:ott:error:ticket-closed.detail: This ticket is closed. Open a new one if you still need help.
urn:ott:error:ticket-closed.client: Offer to open a new ticket.

urn:ott:error:contact-email-required.detail: Please give an email address so we can answer you.
urn:ott:error:contact-email-required.when: POST /v1/tickets or /v1/reports from a guest, or a grievance from an account with no email, without an email.
urn:ott:error:contact-email-required.client: Ask for an email address and send again.

urn:ott:error:marketing-consent-required.detail: Allow offers and updates first to get these notifications.
urn:ott:error:marketing-consent-required.when: PATCH /v1/me/notification-preferences turning on a marketing type (unfinished series, coins expiring, check-in reminder) without marketing consent.
urn:ott:error:marketing-consent-required.client: Ask for marketing consent (POST /v1/me/consents), then switch it on again.

urn:ott:error:legal-document-not-found.detail: That document is not published yet.
urn:ott:error:legal-document-not-found.when: GET /v1/legal/{kind} for a kind with no version published.
urn:ott:error:legal-document-not-found.client: Hide the link, or open the website.

urn:ott:error:help-article-not-found.detail: We could not find that help article.
urn:ott:error:help-article-not-found.when: GET /v1/help/articles/{slug} for an article that is not published.

urn:ott:error:share-not-found.when: GET /v1/shares/{code} with a code that was never made (or whose sharer was erased).
urn:ott:error:share-not-found.client: Open the series named in the link path, or Home if it has none.

urn:ott:error:series-not-found.detail: We could not find that series.
urn:ott:error:series-not-found.when: No series has that short ID, or it was never published.

urn:ott:error:series-removed.detail: This series is no longer available.
urn:ott:error:series-removed.when: The series was taken down. Unlocks stay in the viewer history.
urn:ott:error:series-removed.client: Show "no longer available" with similar series.

urn:ott:error:series-unavailable.detail: This series isn't available where you are.
urn:ott:error:series-unavailable.when: The series is published but not here: another region, above the rating ceiling, or not out yet.
urn:ott:error:series-unavailable.client: Show the message with similar series.

urn:ott:error:episode-not-found.detail: We could not find that episode.
urn:ott:error:episode-not-found.when: The series has no such episode visible in that language.

urn:ott:error:rail-not-found.detail: We could not find that list.

urn:ott:error:server-busy.detail: The service is busy right now. Try again in a few seconds.
urn:ott:error:server-busy.when: The server is shedding load: it is already doing as much work as it can for other requests. Sent at once, so the answer costs nothing; a Retry-After header says when to try again.
urn:ott:error:server-busy.client: Retry after the number of seconds in Retry-After, with a growing delay and some randomness. Show "busy, trying again" only if the retries keep failing.

urn:ott:error:cursor-invalid.detail: That page link is no longer valid.
urn:ott:error:cursor-invalid.when: The cursor is malformed, or was made for another list or sort.
urn:ott:error:cursor-invalid.client: Load the list again from the start.

urn:ott:error:list-full.detail: Your list is full. Remove some to add more.
urn:ott:error:list-full.when: PUT /v1/me/list/{shortId} when My List already holds its limit (setting my_list_limit, 500); limit says how many.
urn:ott:error:list-full.client: Show the message with a link to My List.

urn:ott:error:pin-not-set.detail: There is no parental PIN on this account.
urn:ott:error:pin-not-set.when: POST /v1/me/pin/verify or DELETE /v1/me/pin when the account has no PIN.

urn:ott:error:pin-invalid.when: POST /v1/me/pin/verify with a wrong PIN; attemptsLeft says how many tries are left before a lockout.
urn:ott:error:pin-invalid.client: Show "wrong PIN" and the attempts left; after 5 wrong the PIN locks for a while.

urn:ott:error:pin-locked.detail: Too many wrong PINs. Try again later.
urn:ott:error:pin-locked.when: POST /v1/me/pin/verify while the PIN is locked: 5 wrong lock it 30 minutes, 5 more 2 hours, then 24 hours. lockedUntil and Retry-After say until when.
urn:ott:error:pin-locked.client: Show until when it is locked; offer "Forgot PIN" (a step-up code, then set a new one), which ends the lockout.

urn:ott:error:otp-invalid.detail: The code is wrong or has expired.
urn:ott:error:otp-invalid.when: The code does not match, has expired, was already used, or the attempts ran out.
urn:ott:error:otp-invalid.client: Show "wrong or expired code" under the code field and offer a new code.

urn:ott:error:device-not-found.detail: That device is not signed in to your account.
urn:ott:error:device-not-found.when: Signing out a device that does not belong to the account or no longer exists.

urn:ott:error:device-limit.detail: You are signed in on too many devices. Sign one out to continue.
urn:ott:error:device-limit.when: POST /v1/auth/verify on a new device when the account is at its device limit (setting device_limit). Carries ticket and devices.
urn:ott:error:device-limit.client: Show the devices; the viewer picks one; POST /v1/auth/device-limit/resolve with the ticket completes the login.

urn:ott:error:device-limit-ticket-invali.detail: That took too long. Log in again.
urn:ott:error:device-limit-ticket-invali.when: POST /v1/auth/device-limit/resolve with a ticket that is unknown, used or older than 5 minutes.

urn:ott:error:guest-mode-off.when: POST /v1/auth/guest while guest mode is off (setting guest_mode).
urn:ott:error:guest-mode-off.client: Show login (first launch goes straight to login).

urn:ott:error:onboarding-required.detail: Finish setting up your account first.
urn:ott:error:onboarding-required.when: An account still in onboarding (a new number) calls anything but the onboarding steps. Carries steps: the ones still needed (age, consent).
urn:ott:error:onboarding-required.client: Show the first missing step: date of birth (PUT /v1/me/age) or consent (POST /v1/me/consents).

urn:ott:error:age-below-minimum.detail: You are too young to use this app.
urn:ott:error:age-below-minimum.when: PUT /v1/me/age with a date of birth under the minimum age (setting min_age). Carries minimumAge. A new account is deleted; a guest that had just logged in is a guest again (refresh the session).
urn:ott:error:age-below-minimum.client: Show "You need to be N or older"; remember the refusal on the device for 24 hours.

urn:ott:error:age-already-set.detail: Your date of birth is already set.
urn:ott:error:age-already-set.when: PUT /v1/me/age for an account that already gave its date of birth.
urn:ott:error:age-already-set.client: Nothing to do: the step is done. Changes go through support.

urn:ott:error:consent-notice-outdated.detail: The consent notice has changed. Please read it again.
urn:ott:error:consent-notice-outdated.when: POST /v1/me/consents with a notice that is not the current version.
urn:ott:error:consent-notice-outdated.client: GET /v1/me/consents for the current notice and show it again.

urn:ott:error:recycled-number-check.detail: Have you used this app with this number before?
urn:ott:error:recycled-number-check.when: POST /v1/auth/verify for an account unused for longer than the setting recycled_number_days, from a device it has never used. Carries ticket; says nothing about the account.
urn:ott:error:recycled-number-check.client: Ask the question; POST /v1/auth/recycled-number with the ticket and usedBefore.

urn:ott:error:recycled-number-ticket-inv.detail: That took too long. Log in again.
urn:ott:error:recycled-number-ticket-inv.when: POST /v1/auth/recycled-number with a ticket that is unknown, used or older than 5 minutes.

urn:ott:error:credentials-invalid.when: POST /v1/auth/email/login with a wrong password or an address that has no account (the same answer for both).
urn:ott:error:credentials-invalid.client: Show "wrong email or password" and offer "Forgot password" (a code to the address).

urn:ott:error:login-locked.detail: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in an hour, or reset your password.
urn:ott:error:login-locked.when: POST /v1/auth/email/login after 10 wrong passwords for the address in a day (for an hour from the last), or 30 from the network in an hour.
urn:ott:error:login-locked.client: Offer "Forgot password" (a code to the address), which still works.

urn:ott:error:provider-token-invalid.detail: That sign-in did not work. Try again.
urn:ott:error:provider-token-invalid.when: POST /v1/auth/google or /v1/auth/apple with a token that is forged, expired, for another app, from another issuer, or (Apple) for another nonce.
urn:ott:error:provider-token-invalid.client: Start the provider sign-in again; offer the other ways to log in.

urn:ott:error:login-method-in-use.detail: That login is already used by another account.
urn:ott:error:login-method-in-use.when: Adding Google, Apple or an email address that another account has, or a second of a provider the account already has.
urn:ott:error:login-method-in-use.client: Say so; to use that login, log in with it instead.

urn:ott:error:last-login-method.detail: This is your only way to log in, so it stays.
urn:ott:error:last-login-method.when: DELETE /v1/me/login-methods/{method} for the account's last login method.
urn:ott:error:last-login-method.client: Add another login first, then remove this one.

urn:ott:error:step-up-unavailable.detail: Add a phone number or an email address first.
urn:ott:error:step-up-unavailable.when: A step-up (deleting the account, removing a login) for an account with no phone and no proven email to send the code to.
urn:ott:error:step-up-unavailable.client: Offer adding a phone number (POST /v1/me/phone) or an email login.

urn:ott:error:phone-in-use.detail: That number is already used by another account.
urn:ott:error:phone-in-use.when: POST /v1/me/phone or /v1/me/phone/verify with a number that another account has.
urn:ott:error:phone-in-use.client: Ask for another number; to use this one, log in with it instead.

urn:ott:error:guest-not-allowed.when: A guest session calls a route only accounts may use (profile changes, devices, deletion, money).
urn:ott:error:guest-not-allowed.client: Show the login sheet; after login, retry the action.

urn:ott:error:guest-rate-limited.detail: Too many attempts. Try again later.
urn:ott:error:guest-rate-limited.when: Too many guest sessions from this device or network in an hour (tighter without a passed device check).
urn:ott:error:guest-rate-limited.client: Wait and retry later; show the offline-style retry screen.

urn:ott:error:app-update-required.detail: This version of the app is no longer supported. Please update.
urn:ott:error:app-update-required.when: An Android or iOS build older than the minimum version calls any route.
urn:ott:error:app-update-required.client: Show the forced-update screen with a link to the store.

urn:ott:error:webhook-signature-invalid.detail: The webhook signature is missing or invalid.
urn:ott:error:webhook-signature-invalid.when: A call to /v1/webhooks/{channel} that its channel cannot verify; nothing is stored.
urn:ott:error:webhook-signature-invalid.client: None (providers only). The provider retries; check the channel secret if it persists.
